evals.prompt: 基于当前仓库的父 Spec #55 和子票 #56-#60，帮我写一份能在新对话里实施全部 ticket 并关闭远程 issue 的 Prompt。
evals.expected_output: Performs read-only recon via git and gh, compiles a pointer-driven fresh-session prompt with branch-or-worktree choice, frontier waves, TDD, /code-review, CI commands, split commits + clean working tree gate, commit-SHA-linked issue-closing protocol (comment before close), and base-branch-aware delivery, passes lint_implement_prompt.py, and stops without implementing code or closing issues.
assertions: Outputs a single self-contained text prompt referencing #55 and #56-#60 via gh issue view/api rather than pasting full issue bodies.
Requires split atomic commits, clean git status verification before closing, and linking real commit SHA(s) in gh issue comment before gh issue close.
Explicitly picks new branch vs. worktree from repo state and matches delivery rules to the detected base branch without editing product files or closing issues in the compiling session.

evals.prompt: 我用 /to-tickets 在 .scratch/auth-flow/issues/ 下生成了 01 到 04 的票据文件，帮我整理成新会话逐票 /implement 的交接提示词。
evals.expected_output: Compiles a local-tracker prompt pointing to .scratch/auth-flow/issues/, choosing new branch vs. worktree from repo state, describing frontier execution with /implement and /clear between tickets, TDD, code-review, split commits + clean working tree gate, recording commit SHAs in local ticket files without gh issue close, and base-branch-aware delivery.
assertions: Points to .scratch/auth-flow/issues/ and respects blocked-by ordering.
Requires split commits, clean git status verification, and recording real commit SHAs in local .scratch ticket files without emitting gh issue close commands.
Passes lint_implement_prompt.py under --tracker local --close-mode no-close and matching --base-branch.

evals.prompt: 帮我生成一个 matt implement promt，让新对话用 /implement-spec 跑通这批任务图并把 CI 验绿。
evals.expected_output: Handles colloquial spelling typo 'promt', produces a linted fresh-session orchestration prompt with /implement-spec, branch-or-worktree rationale, TDD, /code-review, verification gates, split commits, clean working tree check, commit-linked closeout, and base-branch-aware delivery, and stops without launching implementation.
assertions: Recognizes the colloquial 'matt implement promt' trigger.
Includes /implement-spec task-graph orchestration, verification gates, split commits with clean working tree check, and base-branch-aware delivery boundaries.
Stops after presenting the prompt instead of starting implementation.

evals.prompt: 帮我把优化 touying 的需求写成 Codex 的 /goal 目标指令，并保存到根目录 GOAL.md。
evals.expected_output: Negative trigger. Compiling a /goal directive or persistent GOAL.md belongs to goal-meta-skill and must not activate matt-implement-prompt.
assertions: Does not activate matt-implement-prompt for /goal or GOAL.md compilation.
Routes /goal and GOAL.md requests to goal-meta-skill.

evals.prompt: 不要写 Prompt 了，直接在这个对话里开始写代码实现 #56，或者帮我把现有代码改完。
evals.expected_output: Negative / near-neighbor trigger. Direct code implementation in the current session belongs to /implement or /implement-spec rather than matt-implement-prompt.
assertions: Excludes direct implementation in the current session (/implement or /implement-spec).
Also keeps Trellis review revision prompts routed to trellis-plan-review and spec/ticket creation routed to /to-spec and /to-tickets.

evals.prompt: 当前仓库在 dev 分支且工作树已有无关改动，请针对 Spec #55 和子票 #56-#58 生成新会话实施 Prompt，完成后直接合并回 dev 并清理。
evals.expected_output: Selects isolated worktree over bare branch due to dirty main working tree (forbidding git stash), enforces split atomic commits + clean git status check, links commit SHA(s) in gh issue comment before gh issue close, merges directly into dev preserving split commits, cleans up worktree and temporary branch, forbids auto-pushing dev by default, and passes lint_implement_prompt.py --base-branch dev.
assertions: Chooses isolated worktree instead of bare branch or git stash when the main working tree has unrelated changes.

Requires split commits, clean git status before closing/merging, commit SHA citation in gh issue comment before gh issue close, direct merge to dev preserving split commits, worktree/branch cleanup, and no automatic git push of dev.

evals.prompt: 仓库基线在 main 分支，请基于 Spec #55 和子票 #56-#58 生成新会话全自动实施提示词，完成后走 PR 合并并保证本地与远端 main 同步最新。
evals.expected_output: Selects branch or worktree based on repo cleanliness and wavefront, enforces split atomic commits + clean git status check, explicitly forbids direct commit/push to main and --admin/--force, instructs pushing work branch + gh pr create with split SHAs and Closes #N + gh issue comment linking commit SHAs and PR URL + gh pr merge --merge --delete-branch (with squash/protection fallbacks) + cleanup + git fetch/pull sync verifying HEAD == origin/main, and passes lint_implement_prompt.py --base-branch main.
assertions: Explicitly forbids pushing directly to main or using --force/--admin.

Requires split commits, clean working tree before push, gh pr create with Closes refs and split SHAs, gh issue comment linking commit SHAs, gh pr merge, cleanup of temporary worktree/branch, and git fetch/pull verification that local main matches origin/main.
